scientific_acceptance: bounded S0-S9 scientific acceptance complete for the recorded task and gates

timing_scope_notes.micro: One lower+compile+execute cold total and three synchronized warm products; library load and preparation separate; native diagnostic collector disabled.
timing_scope_notes.formal: stages.task_wall, independent geometry-to-result fresh objects; actual method/grid/basis/roots and per-repeat imported source/library provenance verified before ratios.
timing_scope_notes.rss: Process high-water RSS includes preparation, compilation and repeats. Formal process-group RSS sampled at 50 ms; no isolated warm-memory claim.
timing_scope_notes.consumers: Diagnostic validation only; before CPU1 versus after CPU8, no timing ratio.
timing_scope_notes.nnao: One first and three updated-parameter full loss+gradient+optimizer steps after preparation. Component run stays diagnostic.
timing_scope_notes.statistics: Single cold sample and three warm samples per clean set; median/min/max are descriptive, not confidence intervals.

nnao_limitations: Random small real-MACE H-only fixture, seed 3, two H2 geometries; not trained-model accuracy.
No validation of real 7171-state campaign constructor/resume or unavailable historical trained checkpoint.
No new NNAO force-supervision/mixed basis-geometry capability.
NPZ masks, parameters, final gradient, optimizer arrays/count and metadata independently checked; driver reports checkpoint roundtrip; no model rerun was used.

first_call_registration_history.interpretation: Twelve derivative-only fresh-process failures exposed registration dependency; twelve fresh cases plus eighteen packed regressions passed afterward (30). Final installed fresh-process group repeats all twelve.

metadata_history: Historical display labels/requested engine fields are retained in raw archives. clean-v3 remeasures all 16 micro pairs and 12 formal worker processes with actual imported package tree hashes and loaded-library identities collected after numerical samples.

profile_analysis.scope: separate instrumented forward PBE TDA CPU1 water/def2-SVP, grid2,5 singlets; no backward call
profile_analysis.confirmed: second new-object run still invokes backend_compile_and_load four times; 4.981880787 seconds cumulative
profile_analysis.limits: nested cumulative times overlap and are not added; not a clean speed ratio or isolated backward cost
profile_analysis.candidate: fresh control-flow/operator function identity; requires a separate dynamic-payload design, not caching the molecule or freezing arrays

coverage_limits: Representative distinct integral/AD paths and stated derivative scopes, not every test in each method suite. FFT/GTH periodic case is an N/A control for molecular libcint, and unsupported derivative limits remain unchanged.
